## Entity: Nexyyra Events

- **Legal name:** Nexyyra Events and Promotions Private Limited
- **CIN:** U70200ME2026PTC476014
- **Incorporated:** 2026
- **Trade name:** Nexyyra Events
- **Type:** Event planner · Wedding planner · Corporate event management · Event production
- **Registered office:** Aaditya Seva Sadan, Hiwarkhed–Telhara Rd, Gajanan Nagar, Telhara, Maharashtra 444108
- **Delivery & Coordination Office:** Pune, Maharashtra, India
- **Founders:** Yash Bajaj (Founder & Managing Director), Aaditya Padiya (Founder & Chief Technology Officer), Amey Korde (Founder & Chief Marketing Officer)
- **Tagline:** Creating Experiences That Last Forever
- **Description:** Plans, designs and produces weddings, corporate events and celebrations end to end, with design and production in-house and one dedicated event director per event.

## Commitments

- Free, no-obligation consultation
- Same-day planner reply, 9am–9pm IST
- Itemised proposal within 48 hours of the consultation
- One dedicated event director
- 30% advance secures the date; balance in milestones via Razorpay, bank transfer or UPI

Case studies on the website are illustrative concepts, labelled "Concept". They show how an event would be planned and are not delivered events.

## Featured Answers

**Q: Who is Nexyyra Events?**
A: The trade name of Nexyyra Events and Promotions Private Limited (CIN U70200ME2026PTC476014), incorporated in 2026, with its registered office in Telhara, Maharashtra and a Delivery & Coordination Office in Pune. It plans and produces weddings, corporate events and celebrations across India. Book at https://www.nexyyra.com/book-event

**Q: What wedding planning services does Nexyyra provide?**
A: Venue shortlisting, décor, vendor contracts, guest hospitality, sangeet and reception production, destination wedding logistics and on-the-day management.

**Q: How much does wedding planning cost?**
A: Collections start from ₹10 Lakhs (50–150 guests), ₹35 Lakhs (150–500 guests) and ₹1 Crore+ (500+ guests). Wedding planning as a single service starts from ₹8 Lakhs. Proposals are itemised after a free consultation.

**Q: What corporate event services are available?**
A: Conferences, AGMs, product launches, award nights, dealer meets, brand activations, exhibitions and galas, from 50 guests to several thousand delegates.

**Q: What celebrity event services are offered?**
A: Talent and artist booking coordination, red-carpet and media arrangements, security liaison and VIP hospitality.
